contests.title: Huerfano County — Recreational and Cultural Facilities and Programming Mill Levy Increase

provenance.quote: SHALL HUERFANO COUNTY TAXES BE INCREASED BY APPROXIMATELY $354,692 ANNUALLY BEGINNING JANUARY 1, 2027, OR BY SUCH AMOUNT AS MAY BE RAISED, BY INCREASING THE COUNTY’S PROPERTY TAX RATE BY AN ADDITIONAL 2 MILLS (ESTIMATED TO BE $13.60 PER YEAR FOR EACH $100,000 OF ACTUAL RESIDENTIAL VALUE), THE REVENUES FROM WHICH SHALL BE DEPOSITED IN A DEDICATED FUND AND USED FOR THE PURPOSES OF: DEVELOPMENT, IMPROVEMENTS, AND MAINTENANCE OF NEW AND EXISTING PARKS AND RECREATIONAL FACILITIES WITHIN HUERFANO COUNTY; MAINTENANCE AND IMPROVEMENTS TO CULTURAL FACILITIES WITHIN HUERFANO COUNTY; AND PROVIDING MORE RECREATIONAL AND CULTURAL OPPORTUNITIES THROUGH NEW AND EXISTING PROGRAMS FOR ALL AGES AND ABILITIES PROVIDED THAT THE FOLLOWING REQUIREMENTS ARE MET: EXPENDITURES FOR THESE PROJECTS AND PROGRAMS BE FIRST SUBMITTED TO AN ADVISORY BOARD FOR A RECOMMENDATION TO THE BOARD OF COUNTY COMMISSIONERS; ANY MUNICIPALITY, SCHOOL DISTRICT, OR SPECIAL DISTRICT WITHIN HUERFANO COUNTY, OR A NONPROFIT SPONSORED BY EITHER THE COUNTY OR A MUNICIPALITY, SCHOOL DISTRICT, OR SPECIAL DISTRICT WITHIN HUERFANO COUNTY IS ELIGIBLE TO SUBMIT PROJECTS AND PROGRAMS FOR FUNDING CONSIDERATION, AND ALL REVENUE AND ANY EARNINGS ON THIS TAX SHALL CONSTITUTE A PERMANENT VOTER-APPROVED REVENUE CHANGE WITHIN THE MEANING OF ARTICLE X, SECTION 20 OF THE COLORADO CONSTITUTION AND AN EXCEPTION TO THE LIMITATIONS SET FORTH IN SECTION 29-1-301 OF THE COLORADO REVISED STATUTES, AND ANY OTHER LAW, ALL AS MORE PARTICULARLY SET FORTH IN BOARD OF COUNTY COMMISSIONERS RESOLUTION NO 26-34 ?
provenance.sourceOrg: Huerfano County Administration / Designated Election Official

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Add 2 mills to the county’s property-tax rate beginning January 1, 2027, for a dedicated recreation and culture fund. The question estimates $354,692 a year, with actual revenue depending on what the levy raises. Money would develop, improve and maintain new and existing parks and recreation facilities; maintain and improve cultural facilities; and provide new and existing recreation and cultural programs for all ages and abilities. All new revenue and earnings would receive the proposed permanent constitutional and other legal revenue-limit exceptions. The question states no tax end date.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the additional county property tax for the stated facilities and programs, its funding-review process and its revenue-limit exceptions.
measureRecords.noMeans: Do not approve this additional property-tax levy or its proposed revenue-limit exceptions.

parts.label: Who may apply and how spending is reviewed
parts.what: Proposed spending must first go to an advisory board for a recommendation to the county commissioners. Municipalities, school districts and special districts within the county may submit projects or programs for funding consideration. A nonprofit may apply if sponsored by the county or one of those local governments.

parts.label: Published household estimate
parts.what: The question estimates an additional $13.60 a year for each $100,000 of actual residential property value.
